director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions ko cricket ke equal shares se samjhenge. Tumhara favourite cricket player kaun hai?
Badhiya, Riya. Socho team ke 4 players ko ek watermelon barabar baantna ho—har player ko kitna hissa milega? Baad mein tum Golu ko sikhaogi.
Bilkul Riya, lesson thodi der ruk sakta hai. Kis baare mein baat karna chahti ho? Button dabakar hum lesson par laut sakte hain.
Theek hai Riya, ab fractions par lautte hain: 4 equal pieces mein har piece one-fourth hota hai. 1/3 mein shape kitne equal pieces mein bategi?
Riya, 1/3 ka matlab 3 equal shares. Example mein 12 pencils ko 3 shares mein baantenge: har share mein 4. Agla step dekhogi?
Chalo spoken game: 1/3 mein teen equal boxes socho; tum ek box choose karke bolo, kaunsa choose karogi?
Sahi, Riya—1/3 mein 3 equal parts hote hain. Ab bolo, inmein se ek part ko fraction mein kaise likhenge?
Riya, fractions ka yeh tareeka boring lag raha hai—picture, story, ya game mein se ek choose karke bolo. Kaunsa?
Riya, kaunsa choose karogi: Picture dikhao, Kahani mein batao, ya Game khelte hain?
Kahani mode on: ab ek chhoti si sharing story se fractions ko samjhenge—jaise lunch ko barabar baantna. Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.
